patterns_found.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
patterns_found.evidence: Price formed a higher low around 1775 after the 1725 swing low, then rallied to a higher high around 1850, breaking the prior swing high near 1825. Market structure has shifted from bearish to bullish.

patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Left shoulder low near 1775, head low near 1725, right shoulder low near 1775-1780. Neckline resistance around 1800-1825 has been breached with price reaching 1850.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Sharp upward impulse from roughly 1775 to 1850 followed by a tight consolidation range between approximately 1810 and 1845.
